label: 木屋 → 金色稻田（4.0）
prompt: Create a 15-second, emotionally devastating cinematic 3D video using two character references. This is a fictional film set depicting a choreographed stunt sequence. Both performers are adult actors. No real harm, no blood, no graphic injury. The "zombie" is a costume performance.
CHARACTER A: [Insert Character A / Reference Image 1]
CHARACTER B: [Insert Character B / Reference Image 2]
Character A is the survivor holding a gun. Character B is someone deeply loved by Character A — their [mother / daughter / partner / best friend / pet] — who has tragically transformed into a zombie.

Preserve the exact facial identity, recognizable hairstyle, body proportions, and distinctive appearance of both characters throughout the video. Their genders, appearances, and relationship can vary depending on the supplied references.
Inside a dark, abandoned rustic wooden cabin, Character A stands trembling, holding a handgun lowered at their side, unable to raise it.
Begin with a tight cinematic close-up of Character A's tearful face.

Character A is crying intensely, tears visibly streaming down their cheeks. Their eyes are red and filled with heartbreak. Their lips tremble, their breathing is uneven, and their hands shake uncontrollably.
Character A desperately tries to lift the weapon but cannot bring themselves to do it.
Cut to Character B slowly walking closer from across the wooden cabin, moving with a stiff, unnatural, performance-style gait — a choreographed zombie walk, not a real threat.
Dim daylight enters through old wooden windows, illuminating floating dust particles. Cold blue-grey lighting and deep shadows create a tragic, oppressive atmosphere.
Cut sharply to an extreme close-up of Character B's undead face.

Character B has pale grey skin, cloudy white eyes, dark veins, hollow facial features, disheveled hair. The expression is frightening and inhuman, yet the character remains unmistakably recognizable as Character B.
Use an intense, nearly motionless close-up with shallow depth of field, capturing subtle facial twitches and unsettling breathing.
No gore, no wounds, no biting, no blood.
**SHOT 3 — THE CHOICE AND THE LEAP (6–10 SECONDS)**
Cut back to Character A, still crying, gun lowered.
Character A hesitates one final time, overwhelmed by grief and love.
Instead of firing, Character A deliberately lets the gun fall away from their hands.
Character A then slowly spreads both arms wide, completely exposing themselves and silently inviting Character B into an embrace.
Their tearful expression shows painful acceptance rather than aggression.
For a brief instant, Character A remains motionless with both arms open.

Suddenly, Character B breaks into a choreographed sprint across the wooden cabin and launches into a controlled airborne stunt leap directly toward Character A — the same physical energy as a tackle, performed as a rehearsed stunt with no contact impact shown. Character B never moves behind Character A.
Character A does not retreat, fight back, or close their arms.
The camera tracks Character B's acceleration and airborne leap in a locked side-angle medium shot.
**SHOT 4 — THE MEMORY / LEAP-TO-HUG MATCH CUT (10–15 SECONDS)**
At the exact apex of the airborne stunt, just before contact, perform an instantaneous cinematic hard cut to black.
The dark wooden cabin becomes an expansive golden wheat field under a breathtaking sunset.

Both characters are now completely alive and healthy, restored to their normal human appearance exactly matching the reference images, wearing clean everyday clothing that fits their original gender and identity.
IMPORTANT: The airborne momentum must continue seamlessly across the cut.
Character B's stunt leap transforms into a joyful, emotional leap into Character A's waiting arms.
The two characters complete the exact same movement, but instead of a performance tackle, it becomes a beautiful, heartfelt embrace.
Character A catches Character B and wraps both arms tightly around them.
Both characters hold each other affectionately, reunited at last.
Their faces express profound relief, tenderness, and bittersweet happiness.
Golden sunlight illuminates their hair and faces. A gentle breeze moves through the surrounding wheat.
The camera slowly pulls back in a locked medium-wide shot to reveal the vast, peaceful wheat field, ending on the two characters embracing beneath the glowing sunset. No orbiting, no circling.

4K cinematic quality, photorealistic 3D rendering, film-quality animation, highly detailed facial expressions, realistic tears, natural skin textures, detailed hair simulation, physically accurate lighting, volumetric sunlight, atmospheric dust, realistic clothing physics, cinematic depth of field, professional film color grading.
First 10 seconds: dark, cold, desaturated, frightening, emotionally tense.
Final 5 seconds: luminous, warm, golden, peaceful, nostalgic, emotionally healing.

Avoid body merging, limb overlap distortion, face morphing, identity drift, extra arms or hands. No rapid camera movement, no orbiting camera. No blood, no gore, no biting, no graphic injury. Keep both faces clearly separated and recognizable in every frame.
First scene: eerie wooden cabin ambience, faint wind, shaky breathing, quiet sobbing, approaching footsteps, rising cinematic tension.
Zombie close-up: unsettling breathing, subtle low-frequency rumble.
The leap: sudden rapid footsteps, dramatic sound swell.
Cut to wheat field: warm ambient wind, soft emotional music swell.
